description: This file defines the BatchWrite interface in the Spark SQL connector package, outlining methods for batch data writing, including creation of writer factories, commit, abort, and handling commit messages, with detailed documentation on the data writing process.

classes.name: BatchWrite
classes.description: An interface defining batch data writing operations in Spark SQL connector, including creation of writer factories, commit, abort, and handling commit messages.

methods.name: createBatchWriterFactory
methods.description: Creates a DataWriterFactory to be serialized and sent to executors, based on physical write info.

methods.name: useCommitCoordinator
methods.description: Indicates whether to use Spark's commit coordinator to ensure at most one task per partition commits.

methods.name: onDataWriterCommit
methods.description: Handles a commit message from a successful data writer.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the writing job with an array of commit messages from data writers.

methods.name: commit (with summary)
methods.description: Commits the writing job with commit messages and an optional write summary.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the writing job, typically due to failures or errors.
